claim.why_it_matters: The amendment's preamble (page 913) says shading marks specifications unique to level 2; pages 919 and 922 render shading with ║...║ markers, but this entry drops the shading, so the replacement sentence reads as applying at every level.

verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 920 shows a dotted gray shade behind the quoted fragment "If the THROUGH phrase is specified" in the instruction line and behind all five lines of the replacement sentence (ending at "being specified."). The markdown for page 920 carries both texts word for word but has no ║ markers anywhere on the page, although the transcription's own convention (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md lines 72-76) renders shaded/boxed text as ║...║. The words are all there; the loss is the shading, which in this addendum marks level-2-only specifications, so the omission changes the normative level of the replacement rule. The claim quotes both sources accurately. The shaded new subitem 4 in the next VI-16 entry has the same omission, but that is recorded separately as p920-2.
